{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: Gogstash
on: [push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch]

    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.x]
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}

      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod

      with:
        args: --verbose --timeout=5m

  build:

      matrix:
        go-version: [1.x]
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      CACHE_VERSION: 2024-02-08.1
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
    - run: go test -v ./...

This preserves all required checks (lint, test, build) and adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, or new network access. No contraindication applies: there is no existing equivalent cache and the cached module content is trusted dependency state.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
